create_log_stream_subclass: create a subclass of LogStream that implements _get_stream_output and stop_stream methods
pause_log_stream: pause the LogStream instance so no log lines are yielded until resumed
resume_log_stream: resume the LogStream instance so log lines are yielded again
set_log_filters: set log filters on the LogStream instance by passing a sequence of filter strings
get_stream_output: get the generator of log lines from a LogStream subclass instance
